newsitem.title: GERMANY: Varig CEO sees 97 sales rev at $3.2 bln.
newsitem.headline: Varig CEO sees 97 sales rev at $3.2 bln.

text.p: Fernando Souza Pinto, chief executive of Varig Brazilian Airlines, said on Wednesday he expected the firm's 1997 sales revenue to rise to $3.2 billion.
Pinto also said he expected passenger numbers to grow by between four and six percent this year to just over 10 million travellers.
Pinto was in Frankfurt attending the launch of the Star Alliance airline network, which Varig will join in October 1997.
"Varig will cover Latin America for the (Star Alliance) network. It was the missing link and now we are there," Pinto told Reuters.
In 1996, Varig reported revenues of $3.0 billion and had 9.7 million passengers.
